name: Esarhaddon's conquest of Egypt
summary: The king of Assyria marches from Nineveh to the Mediterranean, crosses Sinai with water carried by the camels of Arab kings, and takes Memphis from the Kushite pharaoh Taharqa. For a few years Assyria rules from the Tigris to the Nile.

stops.note: Tyre, allied with Taharqa, is put under siege on the way.
Arab kings bring camels and water for the army's crossing.
Memphis falls; Taharqa flees south to Kush, and his family is taken to Nineveh.
